If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for bearish bias.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is rising, cap upward slope at +1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overshoot.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is falling, add 0.3–0.7% downward bias for late horizon to align with negative sentiment momentum.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 within 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for early horizon to reflect extreme bullish reversal risk.  
If sentiment drops to 0.00 within 3 days, increase forecast by 0.8–1.5% for mid horizon to counteract bearish sentiment drift.
